lobby: Golden Hour Boardwalk - pass10 explicit geometry
units: studs; 1 Blender unit = 1 stud; all sizes/positions in Roblox axes (X east, Y up, Z south)

axes.fbx: axis_forward -Z, axis_up Y, scale 1.0, transforms applied (identity objects)
axes.yaw: deg about +Y (CFrame.Angles(0, rad(yaw), 0)); props are built at yaw 0 in the lobby.json frame

BW_Neon.note: emissive parts, own MeshPart, flat colour, no texture

BW_Backdrop.note: vertex colour only (bw_sea_stacks, bw_rock_arch); no texture

Glow_Crystal.note: Neon in Roblox, keep Brightness low / or use SmoothPlastic + slight glow if Neon blows out

Glow_Tips.note: Aurora crown tips, separate material mesh

import_notes: Import each FBX at scale 1.0 (1 unit = 1 stud).
Anchored=true, CanCollide=false, CanQuery=false, CanTouch=false on every MeshPart; gameplay collision = the collision[] boxes (invisible Parts) or lobby.json colliders.
BW_Neon MeshParts: Material=Neon, Color from parts[].color.
Each FBX = one mesh per material (+ named faces: card_face_1..3, panel_1..3, plate_face) sharing the prop pivot.
